title: CONFIRMATION: does the expert-forecaster lever replicate on a fresh disjoint slice? (#342)
design: Re-run comparative + popshare (Sonnet + Groq) on a SECOND disjoint 150-case slice (excludes the first levers/iter2 slice AND the original 60). Tests replication of the lever found on slice-1.

hypotheses.H1: comparative_sonnet replicates: balanced SMR Wilson 90% LB > 0.5 AND Kendall tau_b 90% LB > 0 on this disjoint slice
hypotheses.H2: the two Sonnet expert-forecaster arms both show spearman rho > 0.10

decision_rule: If comparative_sonnet replicates (SMR LB>0.5 AND tau_b LB>0) -> the elicitation-format lever is CONFIRMED (real, ~2x slices, pre-registered); worth scaling + reporting as a genuine accuracy gain (still sub-decision-grade). If it collapses to chance -> slice-1 was noise; format is not a robust lever; pivot to supervised feature+calibration avenue.
